default.q.toriaezu_goi_n3-t1-q10.why.3: ✗ (d) The kanji 量 means quantity or measured volume; it is not used to refer to the wages received by workers.

To distinguish the four basic operations, remember their particles: addition uses 「AにBを足す」, subtraction uses 「AからBを引く」, multiplication uses 「AにBをかける」, and division uses 「AをBで割る」.

default.q.toriaezu_goi_n3-t1-q20.why.2: ✗ (c) 「かける」 means “multiply.” Multiplying 420 by 385 produces a very large number, not 35.
default.q.toriaezu_goi_n3-t1-q20.why.3: ✗ (d) 「割る」 means “to divide,” while 420 divided by 385 is approximately 1.09, not 35.
